environment: Google Antigravity IDE (agent manager, agy CLI)
blockers: ffmpeg, Pillow and google-genai must be installed by the user (env_probe.py reports them)
Application Default Credentials and an explicit --project are required for --execute
no built-in image/video tool callable by the IDE agent: Path C, never Path B
notes: UNVERIFIED: shell tool name run_command and the file tool names are not verified by a public document. Known issues at the time of writing: the global skills directory is not always picked up and ~/.agents/skills is not picked up by the CLI, therefore the workspace .agent/skills/ directory is the primary install target (install.sh writes .agent/skills and .agents/skills with --project-dir). The IDE's artifact/browser image generation is not a tool the skill can call.
